label: Gerunds (Деепричастия)
description: A 20-question check on the gerunds lessons.

questions.prompt: In «Читая письмо, она тихо улыбалась», what does the gerund читая mean?
questions.explain: Читая is the imperfective gerund of читать and names an action happening at the same time as the main verb — she read while she smiled.

questions.prompt: An imperfective gerund such as читая or делая marks an action that happens…
options: after the main verb is finished
at the same time as the main verb
questions.explain: The lessons stress that the imperfective gerund signals simultaneity — the action overlaps with the main verb, not sequence.

questions.prompt: In «Купив билеты, мы пошли в кино», when did the buying happen relative to going to the cinema?
questions.explain: Купив is a perfective gerund, so it marks an action completed before the main verb — they bought the tickets, then went.

questions.prompt: Why does the form stay читая in «Студенты молчали, читая трудный учебник» even though студенты is plural?
options: it agrees with a hidden singular noun
gerunds are indeclinable and take no number ending
the plural ending was dropped for style
questions.explain: Gerunds are indeclinable: one fixed form serves every number, person and gender, unlike a participle which would agree.

questions.prompt: The same-subject rule the lessons stress means that…
options: the gerund and the main verb must be done by the same subject
the gerund needs its own separate subject
the two verbs must be in the same tense
questions.explain: As in «Читая эту книгу, я многое узнаю», the doer of the gerund must be the doer of the main verb; a gerund cannot take its own subject.

questions.prompt: Which suffix forms an imperfective gerund from a non-reflexive verb (e.g. делать → делая)?
questions.explain: Imperfective gerunds are built from the present stem plus -я, as in делая from дела-ют.

questions.prompt: In «Прочитав письмо, она заплакала», what does прочитав mean?
questions.explain: Прочитав is the perfective gerund of прочитать — she finished reading, then cried.

questions.prompt: Why is придя (from прийти) called an irregular perfective gerund?
options: it takes -дя instead of the usual -в
questions.explain: Придя is irregular: instead of the usual perfective -в it takes a -дя ending on the perfective stem.

questions.prompt: The reflexive gerund улыбаясь (from улыбаться) keeps its reflexive marker as which ending?
questions.explain: Reflexive imperfective verbs keep the reflexive marker in the gerund as -ясь, not plain -я.

questions.prompt: In «Возвращаясь домой, она купила хлеб», возвращаясь tells us she bought bread…
options: while she was on the way home
questions.explain: Возвращаясь is an imperfective reflexive gerund — the buying happened simultaneously, on the way home.

questions.prompt: Which suffix forms the reflexive perfective gerund вернувшись (from вернуться)?
questions.explain: Reflexive verbs take -вшись for the perfective gerund, carrying the reflexive -ся, as in вернувшись.

questions.prompt: In «Сделав уроки, он пошёл гулять», what does сделав convey?
options: he finished the homework, then went out
he went out, then did homework
questions.explain: Сделав is a perfective gerund of сделать — the homework was completed first, then he went out.

questions.prompt: How does a participle like читающий differ from the gerund читая?
options: the participle inflects for gender, number and case; the gerund does not
the gerund inflects but the participle does not
questions.explain: The lessons contrast the indeclinable gerund читая with the participle читающий, which agrees for gender, number and case.

questions.prompt: In «Завтра, читая доклад, я буду волноваться», why does читая stay unchanged even with a future main clause?
options: the gerund has no future form and keeps one shape
it changes to a perfective gerund
questions.explain: The gerund has no future form; читая stays fixed while the reading and the worrying happen together.

questions.prompt: In «Написав письмо, он пошёл на почту», what does написав mean?
questions.explain: Написав is the perfective gerund of написать — he finished the letter, then went to the post office.

questions.prompt: In «Он сидел в кресле, читая газету», how do сидел and читая relate?
options: both run alongside each other, one subject
questions.explain: The imperfective gerund читая runs parallel to сидел; both actions belong to он and happen simultaneously.

questions.prompt: The set phrase «Говоря честно» works as a frozen connector meaning roughly…
questions.explain: Говоря честно is an idiomatic gerund phrase meaning frankly speaking, fixed because gerunds are indeclinable.

questions.prompt: In «Увидев маму, ребёнок побежал к ней», what is the order of events?
options: he saw mama, then ran to her
he saw and ran at the same instant only
questions.explain: Увидев is a perfective gerund — the child caught sight of mama first, then ran to her.

questions.prompt: In «Слушая музыку, она готовила ужин», what does слушая describe?
questions.explain: Слушая is an imperfective gerund — she listened to music while cooking, the two actions overlapping.

questions.prompt: A perfective gerund like купив in «Купив квартиру, я плачу ипотеку» shows the buying as completed even though the main verb плачу is present. What does this tell us?
options: the perfective gerund means completion regardless of the main clause's tense
the gerund forces the main verb into the past
present main verbs cancel the gerund
questions.explain: A perfective gerund marks a finished prior action whatever the main tense — the flat is bought, and now I pay the mortgage.
